description: This file contains a class 'ConsumerEventCountingGrain' which implements an Orleans grain that consumes stream events. It manages subscriptions, counts items received, and handles activation/deactivation.

classes.name: ConsumerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that subscribes to a stream, counts incoming events, and manages its subscription lifecycle.

classes.name: AsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncObserver to handle received stream items asynchronously.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles initialization when the grain is activated, resetting counters and subscriptions.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the grain is deactivated, stopping stream consumption.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream given its ID and provider name.

methods.name: EventArrived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an event arrives on the stream; increments count and logs info.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the stream and cleans up resources.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of events consumed so far.
